meta.name: add-clidash
meta.description: Add clidash — a zero-dependency, read-only web dashboard that derives its tabs and tables at runtime from any CLI that lists resources as JSON. Ships pre-wired for NanoClaw's ncl CLI (agent groups, sessions, channels, users, roles), plus message-activity charts, a log tail, and a read-only file viewer for group skills/CLAUDE.md/profiles.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将任意 JSON 输出 CLI 转为实时 Web 仪表盘
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你有输出 JSON 的 CLI 工具，想快速生成 Web 仪表盘
copy.tagline_en: Turn any JSON-output CLI into a live web dashboard
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a CLI that outputs JSON and want a quick web dashboard

howto.what: 装好后会启动一个本地只读网页看板,读取能列出 JSON 资源的 CLI(如 ncl),为每个资源生成标签页和表格,并显示活动图表、日志尾部、只读文件查看器。
howto.when: 当你要为 ncl、docker 等能输出 JSON 的 CLI 搭建只读网页看板时;装上后按步骤复制目录、建配置并运行 node server.js 启动。

say.note: 它会复制 tools/clidash 并生成配置文件

say.text: 给 clidash 再加一个 docker 标签页
把 clidash 配成后台服务,只绑 127.0.0.1
say.note: 会给出 systemd 或 launchd 配置写法

howto.what_en: After install, Claude runs a small local read-only web dashboard that reads any CLI listing JSON resources (e.g. ncl, docker) and builds one tab and table per resource, plus activity charts, a log tail, and a read-only file viewer.
howto.when_en: Use when you want a read-only web dashboard over a JSON-listing CLI such as ncl or docker; it is installed by copying the tool directory, creating a config, and running node server.js.

say_en.text: Install clidash and wire it to my existing ncl CLI
say_en.note: Copies tools/clidash and creates the config.

say_en.text: Add a docker tab to clidash
Run clidash as a service bound to 127.0.0.1 only
say_en.note: Gives a systemd or launchd unit.
